summary: Benchmark-and-decision lifecycle for consequential internal capabilities versus external state of the art. Evidence producers feed the canonical evidence lifecycle in JOV-5916; this registry owns only the benchmark object, sourcing decision, and capacity contract. No second ledger, no clock-based sweep, no router rewrite is authorized.

lowValueAccumulation.threshold: accumulate until relevance or expected value crosses threshold

evidenceProducers.note: Weekly idea-discovery sweep emits signals into the canonical evidence lifecycle; it is not a benchmark authority.

domains.userOutcome: Real bugs caught before merge at acceptable false-positive, latency, and cost burden.

taskSuite.ref: versioned task set to be materialized from landed-fix history and seeded-bug fixtures before the first run; the suite id and version are pinned here so rerun comparisons stay cohort-stable
taskSuite.groundTruth: independent rubric over known injected and historically confirmed defects; marketing claims never count as proof
adversarialCases: architecture-boundary violations invisible to diff-only review

candidates.provenance: Jovie internal review machinery: scripts/agent/preflight, autoplan review pipeline, and in-repo review skills on exact HEAD
a managed code-review vendor (e.g. the system referred to as CodeRabbit); current identity, version, and capability must be verified before results count
a public code-review agent repository; pin the exact tag/commit and verify identity at run time

decision.expectedEconomics: status quo until the first shadow/replay run produces certified outcome and cost evidence
decision.dependencyRisk: none added; external challenger runs only as signal, not a runtime dependency
decision.reversibility: fully reversible; no production review path depends on the challenger
decision.reEvaluateTrigger: first versioned task-suite run completes, or any material trigger event for this domain

oviEscalation.routineAuthority: autonomous adoption with an outcome receipt
